facts.fact: The WURI-Niger project's civil-status page states that a digital platform for managing civil-status events has been put into service in 100 communes, against 266 principal centres, with extension to 166 further communes and 38 diplomatic missions listed as to come (100 of 266, the share computed here); the page is undated and its content looks back to 2023 and forward from December 2024, so the proxy published year is used.
facts.system: plateforme digitale de gestion des faits d'état civil

facts.fact: The WURI-Niger page (undated; proxy published year used) says the World Bank-backed WURI programme supports civil status by strengthening digital infrastructure and financing the integration of the national register with existing identification systems; it names no domestic budget line.
facts.system: plateforme digitale de gestion des faits d'état civil

facts.fact: The WURI-Niger page (undated; proxy published year used) lists the platform among the achievements of Niger's civil-status administration: a Direction Générale de l'État Civil, 8 regional and 63 departmental directorates, 266 principal centres and 13,939 declaration centres in villages and health facilities.
facts.system: plateforme digitale de gestion des faits d'état civil
